profile.visual_desc: Massive human in dark navy spiked plate armor with a single brown horn and a bright blue loincloth.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Profile of a navy helmet featuring a prominent horn and menacing glowing red eyes within a dark visor.
profile.weapon_desc: Enormous two-handed silver greatsword with a circular guard, gripped firmly by both hands.
profile.step1_ready: Standing isometric ↘ stance with legs braced, holding the heavy blade low and behind the body.
profile.step2_windup: Rotates torso and hoists the massive sword vertically above the head to prepare a heavy downward strike.
profile.step3_impact: Lunges forward ↘ while swinging the blade down, creating a wide vertical golden energy arc.
profile.step4_finish: Maintains a deep forward lunge as the golden energy trail dissipates, resting the sword at the low point.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy arc in Frame 4 must precisely follow the downward vertical trajectory of the greatsword's swing.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation captures reference weight effectively. Windup and VFX alignment match source frames well.
